facts.fact: The Commission enforces the Data Protection Act, 2012 (Act 843), which the Executive Director said was passed 14 years ago.
The Commission's Executive Director and Director of Regulatory and Compliance are acting in post and ran the 12 October 2026 exercise.
The Commission recorded 2,575 controller registrations in 2026 and inspected organisations' registration status and data handling, finding expired certificates.
